name: Mans Role Regarding Animals
overview: Scripture reveals that man's role regarding animals is one of divinely appointed dominion and responsible stewardship, as God created man in His image and granted him authority over all living creatures (Genesis 1:26, 1:28). This dominion includes caring for and managing animals with integrity, reflected in commands to restore lost livestock to their owners and to treat working animals justly (Deuteronomy 22:1; 25:4). Additionally, the wisdom found in observing animals points to God's design and invites man to learn from His creation (Job 12:7). Thus, man's role is both authoritative and compassionate, grounded in obedience to God's commands.
